scope: Display-only map refinement; simulator, observations, inputs and rewards are unchanged.

sources.role: Optional current national cartographic context beneath the pinned domain terrain image
sources.limitations: Live service, not a frozen 2021 map, routing dataset or extension of simulation coverage. No bulk download. Offline terrain and simulation do not depend on tile availability.

navigation.national_locator: Simulation domain, derived only from public map metadata

display.fire_evolution: Rebuild burning-cell fills and their shared external edges from each selected frame; no interpolated propagation or continuous animation
display.actor_view: Only burning sensor observations received by the frame time; stale after four model minutes. No invented intensity, burn scars, ignition times or containment claims.
display.evaluator_view: Explicit existing live-only truth gate; private simulator heat and inactive burned cells, never used in actor history or public exports.

checks.frontend_command: cd ui && npm test && npm run build
browser: Full Spain overview includes mainland, Balearics and Canaries; Fit domain returns to local shaded terrain
National view keeps the domain locator without regional marker clutter
Stepped topo-dev-000 and stress-train-819509b0e2b7a8e0-v0 through real simulator decisions, with playback paused
Explicit evaluator view rendered active heat and subsequent inactive burned cells
History at decision zero hides live private truth and disables mutations; return to live restores the current frame
Final preview is actor-only, paused, at the national overview
checks.limitations: Visual smoke checks and deterministic frontend/backend tests, not new physical validation or held-out policy evaluation.
